o1.biggest_strength: Clear ranked three-fix plan with strong money maths and a useful bolder swap-first idea.
o1.biggest_mistake: Hardcoded November/Christmas dates and a half-traffic fit-finder test do not line up cleanly with the 30-40% usage used in the savings.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Use relative weeks, resolve the fit-finder test/rollout assumption, and add the pre-dispatch size-switch and a 5-day fit follow-up.

o2.biggest_strength: The fullest usable package: pre-dispatch size switch, post-delivery fit help, clear portal changes, and conservative caveated numbers.
o2.biggest_mistake: The best new idea, the 2-hour size switch, depends on an unverified order-edit window; the swap figure is sales kept, not cash saved, and could be misread.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add a simple target-vs-baseline scorecard and gift-order copy for Amira, and confirm the order-edit and swap mechanics before rollout.

reason: I would hand Output 2 to my team first: it has the more complete message set, a smarter pre-dispatch size fix, better post-delivery fit help, and more careful numbers. Output 1 is strong on the core fixes and savings, but its date and test assumptions make it less ready.
